inputs.name: hand over from Model Serving Endpoint to Logging and Observability

output.level_0: The endpoint crashes silently, and nobody notices until stores order blind at dawn.
output.level_1: No logs exist for the serving endpoint, so failures remain invisible to the team.
output.level_2: An engineer manually checks the endpoint health dashboard every morning before the order window.
output.level_3: The endpoint automatically streams latency and error metrics to a central observability dashboard.
output.level_4: Serving logs are governed with retention policies, ensuring audit trails for every forecast request.
